input: hey what's up with order a1029
why_this_case_exists: Production incident: a customer typed their order ID in lowercase. The original regex's letter class was `[A-Z]` (uppercase only), so order_id came back null and the agent asked the customer to repeat information it already had. Fixed by widening the class to `[A-Za-z]` and normalizing with .upper() on the extracted match.
